'''Miscellaneous''' ---- This page contains all miscellaneous articles pertaining to random assortments of game knowledge.
{| style="min-width:700px; width: 85%; margin:0 auto" class="empty-table pad-5 align-center" |[[File:Tdsorganizationcrest.png|200px]] |'''[[Story]]''' [[Tower Defense Simulator]] contains a story, which mainly revolves around the [[T.D.S. Organization]] keeping the [[Overworld]] and other realms stable, while also securing any [[God Cube]] fragments. Currently, most of the story is contained within limited-time events and promotional videos. Read more about it [[Story|here]]. |- |[[File:PlushieCommander2.png|200px]] |'''[[Tower Defense Simulator Toys|Toys]]''' There are various Tower Defense Simulator-themed Toys, generally sold by Roblox or Paradoxum Games, which can be mini-figures or plushies. They are based on multiple things that appear in the game, such as towers, enemies or units. See them all [[Tower Defense Simulator Toys|here]]. |- |[[File:Frontline mens black transparent.png|200px]] |'''[[Merchandise]]''' Tower Defense Simulator has '''Merchandise''' themed around the game, with designs based on elements and characters of Tower Defense Simulator. See them all [[Merchandise|here]]. |- |[[File:ScoutRender.png|200px]] |'''[[How to Play]]''' This is a guide for new players through the mechanics, controls and functions of the game, though it can be referred to later on during the game. Read more about it [[How to Play|here]]. |- |[[File:Music.png|200px]] |'''[[Soundtrack]]''' Tower Defense Simulator uses a wide range of soundtracks, many of them original, others taken from certain music sources. The game itself has dedicated music composers ([https://www.roblox.com/users/17914141/profile Phoqus] and [https://www.roblox.com/users/31164652/profile Enthrallist]) who create most of the music themselves. All soundtracks can be found [[Soundtrack|here]]. |- |[[File:Soundtrack.png|200px]] |'''[[Ambience]]''' Tower Defense Simulator has ambience sounds play in the background in specific parts of the game. These are, most often, long audios that play on loop, similarly to [[Soundtrack|Soundtracks]], though these are separate and have different purposes. Read more about it [[Ambience|here]]. |- |[[File:TankReleaseIcon_(1).png|200px]] |'''[[Thumbnails]]''' Tower Defense Simulator has used a wide range of images to promote and represent the game. A collection of thumbnails, icons and promotional images can be seen on the page. Read more about it [[Thumbnails|here]]. |- |[[File:HardcoreThumbnail.jpg|200px]] |'''[[Trailers]]''' '''Trailers''' are videos that appear on the main game page of Tower Defense Simulator. They are usually up to 30 seconds long, usually being meant to give a brief look into the game following an [[Update Log|update]] or [[Events|event]]. Read more about it [[Trailers|here]]. |- |[[File:TowerOfEggs.png|200px]] |'''[[Badges]]''' '''Badges''' are obtained for either beating maps, leveling up, beating events and miscellaneous stuff. Read more about it [[Badges|here]]. |- |[[File:UpdateLogIcon.png|200px]] |'''[[Update Log]]''' The game has developed quite considerably over the years. It has undergone considerable change since the game was created on the 5th of June 2019. All development logs since the game was released to BETA can be found [[Update Log|here]]. |- |[[File:Paradoxum.png|200px]] |'''[[Paradoxum Games]]''' '''Paradoxum Games''' is the Roblox group developing Tower Defense Simulator. Read more about it [[Paradoxum Games|here]]. |- |[[File:RedSquare.png|200px]] |'''[[Paradoxum Translators]]''' '''Paradoxum Translators''' is the Roblox group dedicated to translating Tower Defense Simulator. Read more about it [[Paradoxum Translators|here]]. |- |[[File:RedSquare.png|200px]] |'''[[Paradoxum Localization Alliance]]''' '''Paradoxum Localization Alliance''' is the Roblox group owner by Razuatix Read more about it [[Paradoxum Translators|here]]. |- |[[File:Paradoxum.png|200px]] |'''[[Paradoxum Project 2]]''' '''Paradoxum Project 2''' is a now defunct group which was initially used to work on other [[Paradoxum Games]] projects. Read more about it [[Paradoxum Project 2|here]]. |- |[[File:ParadoxumTesters.png|200px]] |'''[[Paradoxum Testers]]''' '''Paradoxum Testers''' was a group used for testing. Read more about it [[Paradoxum Testers|here]]. |- |[[File:Rocketeer4.png|200px]] |'''[[bark woof]]''' '''bark woof''', formally known as '''Bark Woof Games''', is a group which was moved to [[Paradoxum Games]]. Read more about it [[bark woof|here]]. |- |[[File:V1.35.0UpdateIcon.png|200px]] |'''[[Tower Defense Simulator]]''' '''Tower Defense Simulator''' is a tower defense game developed by [[Paradoxum Games]]. Read more about it [[Tower Defense Simulator|here]]. |- |[[File:TestPlaceIcon.png|200px]] |'''[[TDS Experimental]]''' '''TDS Experimental''' is used by the developers to test changes made to the game, which anyone can participate in. Read more about it [[TDS Experimental|here]]. |- |[[File:JohnArt.png|200px]] |'''[[Discord Art Contest Winners]]''' On the Tower Defense Simulator Discord, occasional art contests are held. Those who win are usually rewarded with a prize, as well as having their artwork featured in the lobby. All winners can be found [[Discord Art Contest Winners|here]]. |- |[[File:BloxyRender.png|200px]] |'''[[Tower Defense Simulator Award Nominations|Award Nominations]]''' Every year, Roblox hosts the Innovation Awards event (formerly the Bloxys). Tower Defense Simulator has been nominated by Roblox in the Bloxys and Innovation Awards multiple times. All nominations can be found [[Tower Defense Simulator Award Nominations|here]]. |- |[[File:RangerClothingVersailor.webp|200px]] |'''[[Clothing]]''' Tower Defense Simulator has various '''Clothing''' made by clothing designers, which are currently only displayed in the game's official Discord server but was at one point shown off in the lobby's clothing area. All clothing can be found [[Clothing|here]]. |- |[[File:EclipseCrown.png|200px]] |'''[[Tower Defense Simulator UGC|UGC]]''' Tower Defense Simulator has UGC made themed around it that can be either bought in the Roblox marketplace, triumphing certain maps or finishing certain quests, All UGC can be found [[Tower Defense Simulator UGC|here]]. |- |[[File:GamepassIcon.png|200px]] |'''[[Gamepasses]]''' '''Gamepasses''' can be purchased with {{Robux|Robux}}. Some '''Gamepasses''' only give cosmetic changes, such as emotes or the ability to change the [[DJ Booth]]'s music, while others are gameplay changing, such as ability to gain level and exclusive towers. Read more about it [[Gamepasses|here]]. |- |[[File:RankBPDevProductIcon.png|200px]] |'''[[Developer Products]]''' '''Developer Products''' can be purchased with {{Robux|Robux}}. '''Developer Products''' have various utilities, gifting other players gamepasses, skipping ranks in the Battle Passes, or making your progression easier by buying coins or gems. Read more about it [[Developer Products|here]]. |- |[[File:Cooldown Icon.png|200px]] |'''[[Firerate Bug]]''' '''The Firerate Bug''', also known as the '''ROF Bug''', is a bug with Roblox's engine which increases a tower's firerate. This bug heavily affects the statistics of fast-firing towers, such as the [[Minigunner]] and [[Accelerator]] by significantly decreasing their DPS, while slow-firing towers like the [[Ranger]] or [[Sniper]] are barely affected. Read more about it [[Firerate Bug|here]]. |} {{BrowseNavBox}} [[Category:Browse]]
